diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_function.pool should depend on aws_cloudwatch_log_group.pool: the log group is named "/aws/lambda/${aws_lambda_function.pool.function_name}", which makes Terraform create the function first, but AWS then auto-creates that same log group with default settings when the function is created. Terraform's subsequent aws_cloudwatch_log_group.pool creation then fails with ResourceAlreadyExistsException (or, if it lands first, the retention/kms_key_id/log_class settings are silently lost to the auto-created group). The aws_lambda_function documentation explicitly recommends depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.example] for this pattern. Note a bare depends_on cannot be added as-is because the log group's name already references the function (creating a cycle) — derive the log group name independently (e.g. from var.config.prefix, which equals the function name) and then order the function after the log group.
